<json>
{
  "states": ["Idle", "ControlConnectionEstablished", "SessionEstablished", "SessionActive", "SessionReleased"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive StartControlConnectionRequest",
      "action": "reply StartControlConnectionReply",
      "to": "ControlConnectionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "ControlConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive OutgoingCallRequest",
      "action": "reply OutgoingCallReply",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "ControlConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive IncomingCallRequest",
      "action": "reply IncomingCallReply",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive IncomingCallConnected",
      "action": "set SessionActive",
      "to": "SessionActive"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",
      "event": "receive CallClearRequest",
      "action": "reply CallDisconnectNotify",
      "to": "SessionReleased"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",
      "event": "receive CallDisconnectNotify",
      "action": "set SessionReleased",
      "to": "SessionReleased"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionReleased",
      "event": "receive StopControlConnectionRequest",
      "action": "reply StopControlConnectionReply",
      "to": "Idle"
    },
    {
      "from": "ControlConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive StopControlConnectionRequest",
      "action": "reply StopControlConnectionReply",
      "to": "Idle"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

      "action": "reply StartControlConnectionReply",
      "to": "ControlConnectionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "ControlConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive OutgoingCallRequest",
      "action": "reply OutgoingCallReply",
      "to": "CallEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "ControlConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive IncomingCallRequest",
      "action": "reply IncomingCallReply",
      "to": "CallEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "CallEstablished",
      "event": "receive CallClearRequest",
      "action": "reply CallDisconnectNotify",

      "event": "timeout 5s",

      "event": "timeout 60s",

      "action": "reply StartControlConnectionReply",

<json>
{
  "states": ["Idle", "WaitCtlReply", "Established", "WaitStopReply", "WaitConnect", "WaitDisconnect"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "send StartControlConnectionRequest",
      "action": "send request",
      "to": "WaitCtlReply"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitCtlReply",
      "event": "receive StartControlConnectionReplyVersionOk",
      "action": "reply ok",
      "to": "Established"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitCtlReply",
      "event": "receive StartControlConnectionReplyVersionNotOk",
      "action": "reply error",
      "to": "WaitStopReply"
    },
    {
      "from": "Established",
      "event": "receive StopControlConnectionRequest",
      "action": "reply reply",
      "to": "WaitStopReply"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitStopReply",
      "event": "receive StopControlConnectionReply",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Idle"
    },
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive IncomingCallRequest",
      "action": "reply reply",
      "to": "WaitConnect"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitConnect",
      "event": "receive IncomingCallReplyAccepting",
      "action": "reply ok",
      "to": "Established"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitConnect",
      "event": "receive IncomingCallReplyNotAccepting",
      "action": "reply error",
      "to": "Idle"
    },
    {
      "from": "Established",
      "event": "receive CallClearRequest",
      "action": "reply reply",
      "to": "WaitDisconnect"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitDisconnect",
      "event": "receive CallDisconnectNotify",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Idle"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": ["InitialWindow", "Transmitting", "WindowClosed"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "InitialWindow",
      "event": "session startup",
      "action": "set sequence number to zero",
      "to": "Transmitting"
    },
    {
      "from": "Transmitting",
      "event": "packet sent with payload",
      "action": "increment sequence number",
      "to": "Transmitting"
    },
    {
      "from": "Transmitting",
      "event": "number of packets awaiting acknowledgment equals current window size",
      "action": "stop sending packets",
      "to": "Transmitting"
    },
    {
      "from": "Transmitting",
      "event": "receive acknowledgment",
      "action": "bump up window size by one packet",
      "to": "Transmitting"
    },
    {
      "from": "Transmitting",
      "event": "timeout occurs on packet",
      "action": "adjust window size to one half its value",
      "to": "WindowClosed"
    },
    {
      "from": "WindowClosed",
      "event": "successful transmission of window's worth of packets",
      "action": "increase window size by one packet",
      "to": "Transmitting"
    },
    {
      "from": "Transmitting",
      "event": "receiver's window overflows",
      "action": "discard excess packets",
      "to": "Transmitting"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
